name: De Quervain Tenosynovitis
summary: De Quervain tenosynovitis is a painful condition of the tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis in the first dorsal compartment at the thumb side of the wrist. The tendon sheath thickens, causing pain with thumb and wrist movement.

blocks.text: De Quervain tenosynovitis is a painful condition of the tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis in the first dorsal compartment at the thumb side of the wrist. The tendon sheath thickens, causing pain with thumb and wrist movement. It is common in new mothers lifting babies, and in repetitive thumb and wrist work [Ref – to verify].

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

rows: Hot, red, swollen tendon sheath with fever

steps: **Radial styloid tenderness, positive Finkelstein or WHAT test, negative grind test:** working diagnosis De Quervain tenosynovitis.
**Start** thumb spica splint, activity change and graded loading. If no improvement in 6 to 8 weeks, medical review for injection.

items: **Thumb spica splint** (wrist and thumb, interphalangeal joint free) for several weeks, especially during aggravating tasks [Ref – to verify].
**Activity change**: lift the baby with forearms supinated and the thumb close to the hand; avoid repeated pinch and wrist deviation.
**Exercise**: after pain settles, isometric then isotonic thumb extension and abduction, wrist radial deviation, grip. **Manual therapy**: limited role.
**Medical**: corticosteroid injection has good short-term evidence [Ref – to verify]; surgery for persistent cases.

blocks.text: Pain on the WHAT or Finkelstein test, pain during lifting, QuickDASH, grip.

items: **Which tendons are involved?** Abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.
**Why compare sides on the Eichhoff test?** It can be painful in healthy people.
**What splint is used?** A thumb spica splint.
**How do you advise a new mother?** Lift with palms up, thumb tucked, and share lifting where possible.
**What must be excluded after a fall?** Scaphoid fracture.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Differentiate De Quervain from thumb CMC OA and scaphoid fracture.
Perform Finkelstein, Eichhoff and WHAT tests correctly.

sections.A: De Quervain mein angoothe ke do tendons (APL aur EPB) apni sheath mein dard dete hain, kalai ke angoothe wali taraf.
sections.B: Kalai ke angoothe wali taraf dard aur kabhi sujan, pakarne, bachcha uthane aur kapra nichodne se barhta hai.
sections.C: Haal mein bachcha paida hua ya bachcha uthana, aur kya haath ke bal gire (scaphoid fracture ka shak).
sections.D: Pehle dorsal compartment ko dabayein, snuffbox (scaphoid), angoothe ki base ka grind test aur Finkelstein.
sections.E: Finkelstein, Eichhoff aur WHAT tests. Eichhoff mein dono taraf compare karein kyunki sehatmand log bhi dard mehsoos kar sakte hain.
sections.F: Angoothe ki base ki arthritis (grind test positive) aur scaphoid fracture (gira tha, snuffbox par dard) se farq karein.
sections.G: Girne ke baad snuffbox par dard (fracture), ya garam laal sooji sheath aur bukhar (infection): foran refer.
sections.H: Gire to pehle scaphoid fracture rule out karein. Phir kalai ke kinare par dard, positive Finkelstein ya WHAT aur negative grind test: De Quervain.
sections.I: Kuch hafte angoothe aur kalai ka splint, dard wale kaam kam karna, aur phir dheere dheere exercise.
sections.M: WHAT ya Finkelstein par dard, uthane mein dard, QuickDASH aur grip dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Is mein APL aur EPB tendons shamil hote hain.
